params.body:
Fixes bevinding een-ingetikte-klantprijs-deed-niets-bij-een-eigen-wagen. Replaces #767, which failed
on two guards doing their job: `PriceScreenMatrixTest` (in tests/Unit, which my local filter never
reached) pinned the old spread, and `RulesIdentityTest` caught a finding slug I had written from
memory instead of from the file name.

**The matrix is worth reading.** For an own vehicle with a typed price of 9999 it expected
`card 12000, index card 12000, buybox 12000, lease block 12000, offer modal 9999, order modal price
12000, order lease row 9999`: five screens on the retail price, two on the typed one, and the two
amounts of a single order modal sitting next to each other in one assertion. It now reads 9999 seven
times.

Tick customer mode on your own vehicle's detail page, the modal asks for a price, you type it, you
save, and nothing changes. No message, no explanation: the buybox keeps showing the retail price.

R S5-4.6 already says the typed price replaces the margin price **"op elk scherm"**. In five of the
six price methods the own-vehicle branch came first, so on an own vehicle the typed price was never
reached: `detailPrice`, `listPrice`, `indexCardPrice`, `orderPrefill` and `leaseBase`. Only
`documentPrefill` had the order right. So this is not a new decision, it is a rule the code did not
keep.

The check moves above the ownership branch in all five. Nothing else changes: with no typed price an
own vehicle still shows its retail price, which is R S5-4.5, and a second test pins that so one fix
does not eat the other rule.

Against the class on main the first test fails with "Failed asserting that 9500.0 is identical to
7250.0": the retail price where the dealer had typed something else.

**What stays open.** That same difference between `documentPrefill` and the rest is why one order
modal shows two amounts for a single vehicle (bevinding
`eigen-wagen-toont-in-klantmodus-de-verkoopprijs`). That case is about the **margin** price, not a
typed one, so it is untouched here and still waits on Ilse. The finding is updated to say which half
is done and which is not, rather than being closed on a half answer.
params.title: A typed customer price wins on every screen
